description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a Data Model Client, including classes for provider proxy, client notifications, and the main client interface for running queries. It includes necessary headers and declares static factory methods for creating and destroying client instances.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: Placeholder for a proxy class to interface with data providers.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: Abstract class defining callback methods for query results and errors.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: Abstract interface for a Data Model client capable of executing queries.

methods.name: dmClient::create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a dmClient object given a data model directory and optional log level.

methods.name: dmClient::destroy
methods.description: Destructor helper method to deallocate a dmClient instance.

methods.name: dmClient::runQuery
methods.description: Method to execute a data model query with specified parameters and notify results or errors.

methods.name: dmClientNotifier::onResult
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful query result retrieval.

methods.name: dmClientNotifier::onError
methods.description: Callback invoked when a query fails with an error.
